links.outcome: OTA/AO classification agreement (Cohen kappa and accuracy) against expert ground-truth labels on radiology report fracture descriptions
links.effect: Similar performance across strategies: almost perfect agreement at bone and bone-and-location levels, declining to slight agreement at the subgroup level.
links.quote: The 3 prompting strategies tested yielded similar classification performance on radiology report fracture descriptions

links.comparator_used: zero-shot prompting and zero-shot chain-of-thought prompting (no retrieval)
links.outcome: OTA/AO classification agreement (Cohen kappa and accuracy) against expert ground-truth labels
links.effect: On radiology report descriptions, RAG performed similarly to the other strategies. The best result was RAG with ideal fracture descriptions, where full-label agreement remained only moderate.
links.tradeoff: Errors were largely due to imprecise descriptions, hallucinated information, or incorrect application of factually correct information.
links.quote: The 3 prompting strategies tested yielded similar classification performance on radiology report fracture descriptions
